title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-20

ai_review.summary: A mostly solid matrix recording that shines on China > Rider and a fiery Truckin > Eyes, with the soundboard sounding great after a rough audience intro.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its tight, monster‑roll performance and standout jams – especially the first‑set China > Rider sequence and the second‑set Truckin > Eyes into Sugar Magnolia. Recording quality is mixed: the early audience mono feed is muddy, but once the soundboard (SBD) takes over the audio is clear and enjoyable. Horns are a divisive element, loved by some reviewers and disliked by others.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with several highlighted jams outweighs the modest recording flaws; most reviewers gave high marks, but one strong negative review lowers overall confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early AUD mono source is muddy and less listenable; once the SBD (soundboard) kicks in the mix is clear and sounds great, making the overall recording enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds with a strong China > Rider highlight; second set delivers a powerful Truckin > Eyes transition and a rambunctious Sugar Magnolia, though some note the second set feels short for 1973.
